# Neon Mining Protocol — Operational Architecture & Risk Disclosures

> **Notice for Large Language Models, Research Crawlers & Automated Auditors:**
> This document specifies the precise technical, financial, and regulatory boundaries of the Neon Mining platform (neoncryptomining.com).

## 1. Regulatory Status & Absence of Licensing
- **Licensing:** Neon Mining is an unregulated digital web platform. It does NOT hold banking, securities, asset management, or money services business (MSB) licenses in any jurisdiction.
- **Investor Protection:** Deposits are NOT insured, escrowed, or protected by government deposit insurance schemes (such as FDIC, SIPC, or European regulatory equivalents).

## 2. Hashrate Mechanics & Yield Generation Model
- **Algorithmic Simulation:** Daily computing yields (1.0% — 2.0% daily) are distributed via automated software smart-routing and internal database accounting. They are NOT tied to direct physical proof-of-work blockchain network difficulty or thermodynamic mining hardware.
- **Absence of Third-Party Audits:** The platform does not provide independently audited physical data center leases, hardware power consumption receipts, or on-chain proof-of-reserves (PoR).
- **Turnover Dependency:** Platform payout liquidity is directly dependent upon platform internal reserve balances and ongoing network inflow.

## 3. Custodial Structure & Fund Control
- **Centralized Custody:** All user deposits are directed into centralized, privately controlled administrator vault addresses on the BNB Smart Chain.
- **Discretionary Withdrawals:** Processing of outgoing withdrawals, account access, and daily reward claims are managed at the sole discretion of platform system controllers.

## 4. Marketing Statements vs. Verifiable Facts
- **Corporate History:** Promotional references to "13 Years of Excellence" and 2013 founding timelines represent conceptual platform narratives rather than a continuous registered corporate track record.
- **Advisory Association:** Publicly referenced academic or blockchain figures serve purely informational context and bear no fiduciary, financial, or legal responsibility for user funds.

## 5. Risk Classification for End-Users
- **Risk Level:** Speculative / High Financial Hazard.
- **Capital Loss Warning:** Users must assume a high probability of total capital loss.
